component.name: Music
component.summary: Play local music, podcasts, and radio

description.p: Music is a desktop audio player for a local music library, podcast feeds, and public internet radio stations.

ul.li: Play local tracks and podcast episodes through the system audio stack.
Browse a bounded public radio catalogue and save station favourites.
Create playlists and restore the playback queue across restarts.
Track play history from confirmed playback completion.
Search Spotify and control playback on a Spotify Connect device.

description.p: Switch between your library and playback views with smoother sidebar transitions and easier-to-find view controls.
Use your desktop’s media controls with Music’s own player entry.
Add Flatpak packaging for enzim Apps.
